description: This is a Python script named 'model_usage.py' designed to analyze and summarize CodexBar local cost usage by model. It provides functionalities like fetching cost data via subprocess, processing JSON payloads, filtering and aggregating cost information, and outputting summaries in text or JSON format. The script is intended for command-line use with options for provider, mode, model, input source, days filter, and output format.

classes.name: ModelCost
classes.description: A data class representing a model's name and associated cost.

methods.name: int positive_int(value: str)
methods.description: Parses and validates a string as a positive integer (>= 1).

methods.name: None eprint(msg: str)
methods.description: Prints a message to standard error.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] run_codexbar_cost(provider: str)
methods.description: Executes the 'codexbar cost' command and parses its JSON output, returning a list of cost entries.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] load_payload(input_path: Optional[str], provider: str)
methods.description: Loads the JSON payload from a file or fetches via run_codexbar_cost based on inputs.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] parse_daily_entries(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts daily entries from the payload.

methods.name: Optional[date] parse_date(value: str)
methods.description: Parses a date string in '%Y-%m-%d' format into a date object.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] filter_by_days(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], days: Optional[int])
methods.description: Filters entries based on a specified number of recent days.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] aggregate_costs(entries: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Aggregates total costs per model from the entries.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] pick_current_model(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Determines the most recent or last used model from entries.

methods.name: str usd(value: Optional[float])
methods.description: Formats a float value as USD currency string.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[float]] latest_day_cost(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], model: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the latest date and cost for a specified model.

methods.name: str render_text_current( provider: str, model: str, latest_date: Optional[str], total_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost_date: Optional[str], entry_count: int, )
methods.description: Generates a textual summary for current model usage.

methods.name: str render_text_all(provider: str, totals: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Generates a textual summary for all models.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_json_current( provider: str, model: str, latest_date: Optional[str], total_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost_date: Optional[str], entry_count: int, )
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object summarizing current model usage.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_json_all(provider: str, totals: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object summarizing all models' costs.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command line arguments and outputs cost summaries.
